item.title: How Sora Shirai Won SLS Sydney In 2024
item.description: Sora Shirai took SLS Sydney 2024 with an absolutely insane bag of tricks.Can he do it again this year? Find out at SLS Sydney, February 14–15.

item.title: SLS Sydney Course Is OUT!
item.description: This SLS Sydney course brings the streets of Sydney straight into the arena. Inspired by Martin Place, an Australian skateboarding landmark in the heart of downtown, the course is built to feel like skating right in the middle of the CBD. From the iconic four-block to features pulled from the city’s architecture, including a shotgun rail that forces real decisions and full commitment. Fast and technical, with no gimmicks. item.title: 2 Weeks Until SLS Sydney
item.description: We’re officially two weeks out from Street League Skateboarding (SLS) Sydney, and the countdown is on. On February 14–15, the world’s best skateboarders land at Ken Rosewall Arena to kick off the 2026 SLS Championship Tour. Expect high-stakes Knockout Rounds on Saturday, followed by Finals and the Best Trick Jam on Sunday. If you want to see skateboarding at its highest level, live and up close, now’s the time to lock it in.

item.title: SLS Sydney Roster Is Locked In
item.description: The SLS Sydney roster is locked in and it's stacked from top to bottom. As we kick off the 2026 season, expect a mix of brand new faces, established legends, and rising stars all ready to battle it out in Sydney. Day 1: Knockout Rounds is your chance to see every skater compete. Day 2: Finals, plus the best trick jam. It’s almost here. February 14-15.

item.title: One Week Until SLS Sydney❗️
item.description: What are you waiting for? You’ve got one week to secure your tickets to SLS Sydney. Two full days of high-energy skateboarding to kick off the 2026 season. Day 1 is your chance to see every skater battle it out in the Knockout Rounds. Day 2 brings the Finals plus the best trick jam. We’ve got a sick course and the best skateboarders in the game. Don’t miss it February 14 and 15 at Ken Rosewall Arena. Get your tickets now.
